host.title: Tenant Host URL
host.description: Your UKG tenant sign-in URL, with no trailing path

options.tooltip: The base vanity URL you use to sign in to UKG Pro WFM — the host only, nothing after the domain. Example: `https://mycompany.prd.mykronos.com`.

#client_id.title: Client ID
#client_id.description: OAuth client id issued by UKG when your tenant is set up.

#client_secret.title: Client Secret
#client_secret.description: OAuth client secret issued by UKG when your tenant is set up.

#username.title: Service Account Username
#username.description: Username of the dedicated UKG service account this extractor signs in as.

#password.title: Service Account Password
#password.description: Password of that UKG service account.
